author: Mark Atwood
text: Spec now exists: draft-atwood-mimi-provider-auth-00 (~/PROJECT/mimi-provider-auth, github MarkAtwood/mimi-provider-auth, private, unsubmitted). Matches current code: record <selector>._mimi.<domain> TXT 'v=MIMI1; k=ed25519; p=<b64>' (empty p = revoked, unknown tags ignored); covers @method @target-uri from + content-digest when there is a body; created+keyid required; tag="mimi" SHOULD; 300s age / 60s skew SHOULD. Differences for mimid to follow: (1) auth failure is 403 not 401 (RFC 9110 needs WWW-Authenticate on 401), optional Accept-Signature; (2) DANE owner is _mimi._client.<domain> (dance Format 1); (3) mTLS: authenticated domain must equal From on every request on the connection. Appendix A has a verifiable Ed25519 test vector (RFC 9421 B.1.4 key) for a unit test.
